# Aurora Solar

Security at Aurora Solar is a shared responsibility. Everyone at our organization acts as a steward of our company information, data, security practices, and assets. We put a security mindset into everything we build. Our Trust Center focuses on security and privacy standards along with resources, controls, and FAQs to help customers understand how seriously we take security at Aurora Solar.
